# ReflectIQ — Personal Sales Performance Intelligence

> ReflectIQ is a private, on-device sales performance intelligence app designed for sales professionals, account executives, consultants, and founders. It enables 3-second client interaction logging, win rate analytics, and on-device AI coaching without storing or uploading confidential deal data to the cloud.

- Website: https://ferrisintech.github.io/reflectiq_www/
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reflectiq-sales-performance/id6803503736
- Category: Sales Performance, Business Productivity, Client Interaction Tracking
- Pricing: Free to download, optional premium subscription & lifetime access
- Privacy Model: 100% on-device local database (SQLite/Hive). Zero cloud syncing of interaction records. Zero telemetry or data selling.

## Core Capabilities
- **Fast 3-Second Logging**: Capture calls, meetings, pitches, and emails in seconds with outcome, confidence level, and energy score.
- **On-Device AI Coaching & Insights**: Local neural intelligence analyzes interaction patterns, negotiation momentum, and closing friction to provide actionable coaching tips directly on the device.
- **Win Rate & Pipeline Intelligence**: Real-time metrics on won, lost, and pending deals with historical trends.
- **Confidence & Energy Tracking**: Correlate psychological readiness and confidence dips with sales performance.
- **Executive PDF Reporting**: Generate clean, shareable performance reports and audit summaries offline.
- **Enterprise-Grade Privacy**: Compliant with NDAs and strict confidentiality requirements because sensitive client notes never leave the user's phone.

## Target Audience
- B2B Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives
- Independent Consultants, Advisors, and Fractional Executives
- Real Estate Brokers and High-Ticket Dealmakers
- Agency Owners and Solo Founders

## Key Differences vs Traditional CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot)
Unlike enterprise CRMs that are built for managerial oversight and require tedious manual data entry, ReflectIQ is built directly for the individual salesperson's personal growth, self-awareness, and deal mastery—completely offline with no mandatory account creation.
